senses.gloss: f. (סטן = שׂטן; cmp. אִיסְטַטָּנִית) a system of information, sycophancy.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 1:5">Macc. I, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Makkot 5a:20">5ᵃ</cite>) <he>אסטנית היא זו</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>איסטטית</he>, Mish. <he>אסטס׳</he>, Y. ed. 1, 7 <cite ref="A01442"><he>איסטיסית</he></cite>) this endless prosecution of witnesses on the information by other witnesses testifying to an alibi would be regular sycophancy. [Maim. reads <cite ref="A02371"><he>אסטיסית</he></cite>.] <cite ref="Tosefta Makkot 1:10">Tosef. Macc. I, 10</cite> <cite ref="A01437"><he>איסטיטית</he></cite>, ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="A01579"><he>איצטניסית</he></cite>).
